Analyzes the codebase to identify the core features and functionalities of the application.
    This endpoint provides a focused view of the main features without generating other document sections.

    The response includes:
    - Feature name
    - Feature description
    - Feature category

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of questions to return

params.name: include_prd_context
params.description: Whether to use PRD context in generating questions

items.docs:
Analyzes the codebase to generate relevant questions that users can ask about the system.
    These questions are designed to help users explore and understand the codebase through the graph visualization.

    The response includes:
    - Question text
    - Question category
    - Question complexity level
    - Total number of questions
    - Requested limit

    Parameters:
    - limit: Maximum number of questions to return (default: 10)
    - include_prd_context: Whether to use PRD context

Retrieve suggested questions for a specific project, optionally filtered by persona and section.
Args:
    project_id (int): The ID of the project.
    persona (str, optional): Filter questions by persona.
    section (str, optional): Filter questions by section.
Returns:
    SuggestedQuestionListResponse: A list of questions matching the criteria.
